scope: Playback pivot-x correction only; existing y pivots and source pixels unchanged.

method.bandPosition: Original measured foot baseline minus 7 through the baseline, inclusive.
method.horizontalSearch: Entire 314px source frame; no fixed x crop or midpoint split.
method.contactEstimator: Equal-weight mean of the two binary-mask component centroids.

roar.note: Contact-only endpoint comparison. It does not assess body, head, arms, weapon, shading, or scale.

victory_spear.note: Contact-only endpoint comparison. It does not assess body, head, arms, weapon, shading, or scale.

victory_trophy.note: Contact-only endpoint comparison. It does not assess body, head, arms, weapon, shading, or scale.

limitations: The foot-component estimator measures pixel silhouettes, not anatomical landmarks or human artistic approval.
Only common horizontal translation is removed. Changes in inter-foot spacing, stance, anatomy, weapon shape or scale remain.
The roar changes its foot spacing during entry and exit; those changes remain visible after midpoint registration.
No uniform scale, warp, source pixel alteration, generated inbetween or runtime promotion is proposed.
Prior fixed-x-region contact centroids clipped feet on some frames; this wider measurement supersedes those contact-centroid estimates, not the source images or y baselines.
validationScope: Source/frame fingerprints checked before applying x pivots. No artistic approval or in-game validation.
